concept: Фантастическое кино: узнаваемые кадры и реквизит космических фильмов — метеорит, голограмма звёздной карты, планета, следы на Марсе, скафандр, андроид, телепорт, марсоход, ракета, НЛО.
style_mood: a cinematic sci-fi adventure; objects look like recognizable props from a classic space movie, simplified into casual game shapes: a few large, chunky, rounded forms, no small technical details; not toys, machines have no cartoon faces or eyes.
palette_note: Sci-Fi: больше холодных фонов (синий, фиолетовый, бирюзовый, ночь) под тёплыми объектами (оранжевый, красный, золото); тёплые фоны только у Марса и хлопушки.

cards.label: Meteorite
cards.object_color: warm rocky brown with a glowing orange-hot leading edge
cards.key_features: a lumpy rounded space rock with small craters, its front edge glowing orange-hot, a short soft glowing tail; no flames, no sparks
cards.pose: The meteorite flies diagonally from the upper right toward the lower left, the glowing trail behind it
cards.story_detail: a short soft stylized trail of warm glow behind it

cards.label: Crop Circles
cards.object: mysterious crop circle formation in a golden wheat field
cards.background_color: golden field with a soft blue sky
cards.scene: crop circles stretching away across a wheat field
cards.key_features: an ASYMMETRIC, flowing pattern pressed into the standing wheat: a large circle with a curving trail of smaller circles of decreasing size sweeping away like a spiral arm, crisp flattened swirls; no aliens, no UFO, no people
cards.pose: The big circle is in the foreground center, the chain of smaller circles curves away diagonally toward the horizon; golden wheat ears frame the bottom edge
cards.backdrop: soft blue sky with a few small fluffy clouds over a low horizon
cards.camera: elevated three-quarter view from a low hill at the edge of the field, strong perspective receding toward the horizon

cards.label: Planet
cards.key_features: a perfectly round, clean sphere with smooth even horizontal color bands and ONE neat, thin, symmetrical flat ring around it, tilted evenly; no moons, no other objects
cards.pose: The ring is tilted diagonally about 20 degrees; the sphere is perfectly circular and the ring is a clean even ellipse

cards.label: Mars Steps
cards.surface: red Martian dust with small pebbles
cards.backdrop: sky with a small distant planet
cards.scene: boot prints in red dust on Mars
cards.story_detail: a small planted flag with a blank pennant
cards.key_features: TWO boot prints side by side — one left foot and one right foot — deep, crisp ribbed soles pressed into the red dust, followed by a short trail of more pairs leading toward the little flag; no people
cards.pose: Seen from above at about 40 degrees; the pair of prints is big in the foreground center, the trail leads to the small flag further back; the flag stays small and low in the frame

cards.label: Spacesuit
cards.object: white astronaut spacesuit costume hanging on a padded hanger on a wheeled wardrobe rack
cards.scene: film costume department: spacesuit on a wardrobe rack
cards.story_detail: the helmet with a reflective golden visor sitting on the top bar of the rack
cards.key_features: a puffy white suit with orange shoulder and knee patches and white gloves, hanging empty (no person) on a golden wardrobe rack with small wheels; clearly a costume on a hanger, not a standing astronaut
cards.pose: Frontal 3/4 view at eye level, the suit spread wide on the hanger so the whole costume reads clearly

cards.label: Android
cards.scene: a robot on a glossy spaceship floor
cards.key_features: a casual, less humanoid robot: a rounded capsule-shaped body, a smooth dome head with one wide glowing cyan visor, a small glowing chest light, short chunky arms and two short sturdy legs; few large smooth parts, no small segments or panel lines; not a toy, no cartoon face
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, standing, the robot in the center
cards.surface: glossy dark purple floor with soft cyan and magenta reflections
cards.backdrop: plain smooth deep purple-navy backdrop with a soft gradient, no corridor, no walls, no light strips

cards.label: Alien
cards.object: green alien climbing up out of a round silver hatch in a spaceship hull
cards.object_color: soft lime green alien, polished silver hatch rim, cream white and coral red hull
cards.scene: close-up of a spaceship hull section with an open top hatch, alien peeking up out of it
cards.key_features: the bottom of the frame is only a close-up section of a curved spaceship hull with a round polished silver hatch ring, NO lid, no door; the alien rises out of the hatch up to its chest: a classic sci-fi alien shape — a large smooth head wider at the top and narrowing to a small chin, big glossy black almond-shaped eyes, a small calm mouth, two thin plain antennae (not glowing, no balls), slim shoulders and thin arms with long fingers resting on the silver rim; no clothes; stylized but not overly cartoonish, not a baby face; curious, not scary
cards.pose: The silver hatch is centered at the bottom, the alien rises out of it in the center up to the chest, big in the frame; clear empty plain wall above the antennae
cards.floor_color: cream white and coral red curved spaceship hull
cards.camera: camera at eye level, frontal with a very slight 3/4 turn

cards.label: Rover
cards.scene: a sandy tan Martian plain; along the horizon a few soft brown-red mesas, taller on one side, fading into a light warm haze
cards.key_features: a simple rounded six-wheel rover: a smooth red body with a white top panel, silver-grey details, six chunky grey wheels with silver hubs, one short silver camera mast with a single round lens, one small white dish antenna; no extra instruments, cables, vents or small parts
cards.pose: 3/4 view at eye level, the whole rover is visible with clear space around it; the rover takes about 60% of the frame width
cards.sky: Soft lavender-purple sky fading to a warm sandy peach glow near the horizon, no clouds
cards.framing: the whole rover is visible with clear space around it, about 60% of the frame width, not cropped

cards.label: Liftoff
cards.background_color: deep navy blue fading up to light sky blue
cards.scene: a clear bright blue sky only, no ground, no launch tower
cards.story_detail: big soft billowing clouds of white and warm orange smoke below the rocket, spreading evenly to both sides
cards.key_features: a classic white rocket with orange bands, a bit shorter and plumper than a real rocket, smoothly rounded nose and body, the stages shown only by color bands, three small rounded fins, a short bright flame under it; no launch tower, no ground, no portholes; casual game proportions, not squashed, not chibi
cards.pose: front view, camera slightly below; the rocket stands perfectly vertical exactly in the horizontal center of the frame, the smoke cloud at the bottom is symmetric
cards.sky: Smooth vertical sky gradient: deep navy blue at the bottom fading up to light sky blue at the top, no clouds, so the smoke reads clearly; no ground and no horizon
cards.framing: the rocket fills most of the frame height, the smoke spreads along the bottom edge
cards.camera: front view, camera slightly below, the whole rocket and the smoke visible, not cropped

cards.label: UFO
cards.scene: a simple smooth green hill under a bright deep-indigo night sky with no clouds; bright saturated night scene, not gloomy
cards.story_detail: a soft cone of mint light beaming down onto the grass
cards.key_features: a round saucer with a clear glass dome on top and a ring of warm glowing lights around the rim; only the saucer, its light beam, the simple hill and the sky — no town, no buildings, no trees, no lamps
cards.pose: The saucer hovers in the upper middle of the frame, medium-sized, the light beam falling onto the hill below; plenty of sky around
